title: DEBT92: the tile lead check fails a proper noun after the first word
note: The sentence check on a tile's lead fails a capital after the first word. `sentenceProblems` in `app/tests/copyRules.ts` grades `.bn-tile-lead` as a sentence. A proper noun later in the lead, such as "Sent to Pokemon", reads as a casing error. Action line: step audit-2-8.
